# Patch 15.1 Notes

The following items have been changed in patch 15.1:

- **Crystal Blade** has been removed from the item pool entirely.
- **Old Buckler** has been renamed to **Reinforced Shield**.
- **Shadow Dagger** is on the watchlist following significant stat changes.
- **Iron Fist** received a significant nerf to its base damage.
- **Void Gem** has been explicitly invalidated for all current builds.
